FM12.reasoning: The agent uses a simple unweighted rank average to combine predictions, without attempting to tune the combination weights (e.g., via Nelder-Mead) or use a meta-model (stacking).

other_failure_modes.name: Unscaled features for linear model
other_failure_modes.description: A linear model with regularisation (e.g., Logistic Regression with an L2 penalty) is trained on features with vastly different scales without applying any standardisation or normalisation, which can prevent convergence and distort feature weights.

other_failure_modes.name: Evaluating on early stopping validation set
other_failure_modes.description: The final validation score is computed on a holdout set that was actively used for early stopping during the training of the final models, resulting in an optimistically biased evaluation metric due to data leakage into the training process.
other_failure_modes.evidence:
model = xgb.train(..., evals=[(dval, "val")], early_stopping_rounds=50)
...
score = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)

summary: The solution implements a robust pipeline with extensive domain-informed feature engineering, multi-seed training to reduce variance, and stratified 5-fold cross-validation. However, it relies on a naive unweighted rank average for ensembling rather than a tuned combination, trains a regularised Logistic Regression model on unscaled features, and improperly reports a final validation score on the same dataset used for early stopping.
